themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including autonomous agents, agentic commerce, and agentic research platforms.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, reviewing, and understanding code, including specific models like Claude Code and Copilot.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or data to simulate human users for testing, research, and analysis, including synthetic data and AI customers.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers AI applications for automating various testing processes in software development, quality assurance, and system evaluation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, often for insights or quick understanding.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Focuses on using AI to analyze and interpret user feedback, reviews, and sentiment to understand customer opinions and emotions.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Addresses how AI tools and techniques are being integrated into the design and user research workflow, including AI design tools and generative design.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, employment, and the nature of work, including concerns about job displacement and the creation of new roles.

themes.name: AI recruitment
themes.description: Covers the use of AI in hiring processes, including candidate screening, matching, and the impact of AI on job markets.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
